name: rai
description: Ra'y (رأي) — restaurant chain survey & feedback platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:up && npm run db:wait && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend
